classification: formal empirical evidence under the registered fixed-policy delayed Markov-TD scope

formal_seed_registry.derivation: every integer in the closed interval

learning.risk: squared Euclidean norm of half-tail PR average

probe.fingerprint: exact equality of sampled stationary state paths; SHA-256 is the implementation-equivalent message
probe.decision: exact T-052 plug-in action from observed match count

comparators.true_rho_oracle: T-050 catalogue minimizer, using the full no-probe total budget
comparators.sample_path_oracle: descriptive only; minimum fixed-q endpoint on the same seed

analysis.cell_endpoint: arithmetic mean risk over 256 formal master seeds
analysis.aggregate: geometric mean of cell controller/strong-fixed ratios of seed means
analysis.common_random_numbers: one common plus 16 private exact Gymnasium trajectory banks shared within each endpoint

bootstrap.unit: complete master-seed column across every registered cell and comparator

mandatory_gates.F1: exact provenance, 84 cells, 256 formal seeds, and 21504 endpoints
mandatory_gates.F2: all risks finite and every message/environment/delay budget valid
mandatory_gates.F3: aggregate point and one-sided 95% upper ratio <= 0.95
mandatory_gates.F4: every task point and Bonferroni one-sided upper ratio <= 0.97
mandatory_gates.F5: both delay point and Bonferroni one-sided upper ratio <= 0.97
mandatory_gates.F6: active-cell improvement point and one-sided 95% lower fraction >= 0.60
mandatory_gates.F7: inactive point and one-sided 95% upper ratio <= 1.05
mandatory_gates.F8: true-rho-oracle point and one-sided 95% upper ratio <= 1.20
mandatory_gates.F9: median selected q is nonincreasing on rho for each overhead
mandatory_gates.F13: formal seed registry is isolated from every pilot
